name: Kamotsu Academy
description: Kamotsu Academy is a clean, focused WordPress block theme designed for commercial driving schools and vocational training facilities. Built around documentary photography, split navigation, and structured timeline layouts, it presents course pathways, yard schedules, and pricing with clarity. Fully compatible with the block editor, the theme provides a calm, functional aesthetic tailored to transport and logistics operations.
